spots.text: Clipped to the board, the last request: SEND UP THE BOOK WITH MY NAME IN IT. Under it, in another hand: WHICH ONE.

secrets.name: The Operator's Room
secrets.text: Behind the hatches, over the room, a cramped attic where somebody sat at the top of the shafts and sent things down. The last request is still clipped to the board.

meta.label: The Dumbwaiters
meta.blurb: A wall of little doors, all open, all with books inside. Some of them are going up and down. You get the feeling they are being sent somewhere, and that you could be too.
